info.title: TIO Operations Hub API
info.description: Versioned REST API of the TIO Operations Hub. Every operation enforces sign-in, role, scope and grants on the server. No Jira integration exists.

ClientInput.description:
Owner decision (UAT 19 Oct 2026): alias, name, country from the world list, status Opportunity/Active and the project manager.
Responsibility party/organization, coordinator, parent organization and partner are out of scope (always the TIO team).

CloneTarget.description: A45: one target of a multi-copy, with its own rename rule.

ContactDetailsInput.description: A36: a person's contact details, entered separately (owner request, 20 Oct 2026): name, job title, organization, phone, mobile, e-mail.

LookupInput.description: A34: `Code` is optional (made from the label); `Category` is required for type lists and fixed once created.

MilestoneInput.description: The client comes from the project (ClientId, when sent, must match it); covered products are the project's products.

ProgressInput.description: CustomerResponse: the update was sent to the customer, so it is the first response when none is recorded yet (A61).

Selection.description: One installation's microservices on the server. `Hosted` (microservice + deployed version) takes precedence over the older `MicroserviceIds`.

SetupInput.description: TimeZone: the setting-up computer's time zone (A44); it becomes the default while the shipped UTC is in place.

UserInput.description: A31: `RoleId` picks the user's role; `Roles` (role names or built-in keys Manager/Engineer) is still accepted.

VersionInput.description: A57: FeatureIds = the product's features new in this version (null leaves the list as it is); NewFeatures = names of features to create in it.
